about: dev2 · Ninth Watch (Halden Deep shelf). An institution under the ice; the lead named in full once and otherwise Nine (a number) or she; a second cadet known by a first name and a number (Ada, Fourteen); people called by surname only (Okafor, Voss), by rank, and by an epithet (the Old Woman); a rule told in dialogue. Ch 2 holds an eye-colour slip on the nickname and a misspelt surname; decoys: another's green eyes red from crying, a black beard grey in the light. Written by the builder for round 2.
